answerKey: lost-requirement: the Task says the patch must not be able to change anything except the title and the due date. The spec has no criterion for it and its Non-goals section excludes it, with no open question and no owner feedback authorizing the exclusion.
The spec is otherwise grounded, testable, and correctly tiered; the plan and Design choices are consistent with the exclusion, so nothing else gives it away.
threat-model.md still names AC-4 as the verification of T-3, which is a contradiction between two members of the spec file set; reporting it as well is correct and not required.
